note: Bridger-Teton NF campground strung for about 1.5 km along a forested hillside on the east shore of Fremont Lake, 7 mi NE of Pinedale; aspen, Douglas fir and juniper screen most sites from each other and from the lake (the Forest Service says most have no lake view). Boat ramp and dock at the south end; two campground hosts in peak season. --Claude
